COURSE TITLE    ECONOMICS II (MACROECONOMICS)
COURSE CODE     10BA2202
COURSE CREDITS  4

Objective:
 1  To acquaint students with basic concepts of Macroeconomics.
 2  To enable the students to enhance the level of understanding by supporting the functioning
     of these concepts with their evolution over the period of time by discussion of various
     Classical and Keynesian Theories.
 3  To orient students to understand and digest interface between Law and Economics by
     discussion of various Laws and Acts which are based on various theories of
    Macroeconomics.


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Define the functioning of Macroeconomic concepts in the real-world phenomenon.
 2  Explain the functioning of Macroeconomic concepts in the real-world phenomenon.
 3  Demonstrate various economic issues and come up with meaningful solutions to the
    economic problems
 4  Analyze and evaluate the private and public sector banking in India
 5  Develop the structural framework and functioning of various Laws and Acts which are
      built upon Macroeconomic Theories and Principles.


Pre-requisite of course:Economics I

COURSE TITLE   LAW OF CONTRACT II
COURSE CODE     10FL2202
COURSE CREDITS  4

Objective:
 1  To make students understand the different kinds of special contracts.
 2  To provide an insight into the justification for special statutory provisions for certain kinds
     of contracts including Contract of Indemnity, Guarantee, Bailment and Pledge.
 3  To make students aware about the laws relating to Contract of Agency and Partnership.
 4  To help students understand the nature of jurisprudence involved in each case and the
     technique of interpreting such law.
 5  To provide students with a practical approach while dealing with special contracts


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Recall concepts of special contracts.
 2  Demonstrate understanding on various principles relating to Contract of Indemnity &
     Guarantee.
 3  Experiment with principles and provisions on Bailment & Pledge
 4  Examine the principle of agency in practice.
 5  Evaluate the difference between Partnership & Limited Liability Partnership Act and
     benefits
 6  Formulate modern contract techniques and develop new drafting skills in the Sale of Goods
     Act, 1930 with amendments.


Pre-requisite of course:Law of Contract-I

COURSE TITLE   LAW THROUGH POPULAR MEDIA
COURSE CODE     10SL0152
COURSE CREDITS  4

Objective:
 1  To familiarize learners with various forms of media dealing with law
 2  To help learners learn legal language through popular media


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Understand and analyze the different courtroom situations in a critical manner.
 2  Use legal language with reference to a particular context.
 3  Create an argument critically in the field of Law.

COURSE TITLE   MOOT COURT TRAINING
COURSE CODE     10FL2203
COURSE CREDITS  2

Objective:
 1  To enhance students' researching, reading, and drafting skills specific to a moot court
     proposition provided by the faculty-coordinator.
 2  To help students understand the concept and setting of a moot court, including learning
     legal terminologies and differentiating between relevant and irrelevant information for
     drafting a moot memorial.
 3  To develop students' presentation skills used in real court settings and build their
     confidence in legal advocacy.


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Identify the legal issues arising from a hypothetical set of facts
 2  Research the law relevant to these legal issues and formulate legal argument based on this
     research;
 3  Advocate an interpretation of the law which is favorable to a particular side of the
    argument;
 4  Apply the law accurately and persuasively
 5  Distinguish any case law which runs contrary to the argument being made
 6  Present this argument articulately and clearly in an oral forma


Pre-requisite of course:N/A
